provenance_disclosure.description: This analysis was planned after inspecting earlier budget audit results. The cohort is reused for additional endpoints. These are exploratory comparisons, not a prospectively registered confirmatory analysis.

estimator_specification.description: Calculates matched differences within each participant and dietary mode, averages eligible matched modes within each participant, and weights participants equally for both point estimate and bootstrap confidence intervals.

target_source_comparisons.interpretation_note: Target attainment error is evaluated relative to each source's own target. Shared-reference outcomes (validity, energy error, runtime, mass, servings, dishes) are reported separately. End-to-end acceptance is decomposed into Stage 2 acceptance and conditional Stage 3 success.

family_a_budget_comparisons.description: Within-mode exact two-sided binomial tests across all budget comparisons (36 primary + 18 secondary)

family_b_target_source_comparisons.description: Within-mode exact two-sided binomial tests for valid-plan rate across all target-source comparisons

family_c_target_source_e2e_comparisons.description: Within-mode exact two-sided binomial tests for end-to-end acceptance across all target-source comparisons

primary.name: e2e
primary.description: End-to-end acceptance (Stage 2 accepted AND Stage 3 accepted)

secondary.name: l1
secondary.description: Mean normalized L1 target error (relative to own target in target-source comparisons)

secondary.name: energy_error_kcal
secondary.description: Absolute deviation from energy prescription in kcal

secondary.name: energy_error_pct
secondary.description: Absolute percentage deviation from energy prescription

secondary.name: mass_g
secondary.description: Total meal plan mass in grams

secondary.name: solver_status
secondary.description: HiGHS status 0 (gap <= 1%), status 1 (timeout valid/no plan), status 2 (infeasible)
